statement: The survivor is Morgan Vale, a 25-year-old male Evacuee-scenario Survivor with Str 10, Dex 10, Int 8, Per 8
The game starts inside evac shelter A-23 on spring day 61 at 8:00 AM
Erin Bergman, a trucker NPC, is in the shelter and will only follow the survivor if the survivor comes back in a few days
The survivor starts with a pocket knife, a smartphone with a flashlight app, a sealed plastic bottle with 2 clean water, a wallet with currency and a matchbook
The shelter's ground floor has stairs leading down to a basement with benches and corridors
The shelter ground floor has a window with curtains on its north wall that opens to the outdoors
The shelter floor holds about 21 small cardboard boxes of protein ration plus planks, nails, a wooden panel and splintered wood
The survivor can craft a wooden club from memory and wields one
The survivor carries 3 protein ration boxes and 2 clean water in a messenger bag
Plan: inspect shelter storage, find safe water and a cooking vessel, then scout carefully
